text:
Mia: Quick heads-up — new open model 'tessera6b' just ingested. We need a short cross-team readiness check: licensing, perf profile, tokenizer sanity, and infra canary. Targeting a canary window Fri 10:00-12:00 UTC. Who can own infra canary?
Jordan: I can take infra canary. Need legal sign-off and a warmup plan. Also will require a routing tweak and warmup tokens.
Natalie: I can do license review. Please attach model source URL + LICENSE file + SHA256 checksum. Aiming to complete Thu AM.
Sam: Curation found a tokenizer mapping issue causing embedding shape mismatch in one edge case — quick snippet below. I'll open a tiny patch.
```
input_ids shape: (1, 1024)
embeddings shape: (1, 1023)  # off by one due to tokenizer pad handling
```
Sam: PR will include unit test and update to tokenization table.
Leo: Runtime note: 4-bit quant profile is fine for short sequences. For seq_len > 2000 we see memory pressure and latency spikes. Propose policy: enable fp16 fallback for long sequences or split at client.
Jordan: Added canary slot Fri 10:00-12:00 UTC. Will need routing policy update and warmup. @eng-infra please review routing change.
models-bot: model ingest created: id=mdl_6201112222_tessera6b, artifacts uploaded to gs://redwood-models/tessera6b-open/ (manifest.json present).
Sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/rw/curation/pulls/4321 — tokenizer mapping fix + tests + changelog. Tagging @QA.
Jordan: CR for infra changes: https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/4312 — need reviewers @Leo, @Sam.
Leo: Reviewing CR #4312 now. One comment on autoscale trigger thresholds.
Natalie: License is Apache-2.0, but there's a third-party tokenizer binary included. We need CLA proof or remove/vendor with provenance.
Mia: I'll reach out to the submitter for CLA and checksum. Also can someone add a short perf summary in the model manifest (p50/p95/p99 tokens/s + memory_mb)? We need it for catalog listing.
Sam: Adding perf summary to manifest now. Example entry I'm adding:
```
"perf": "{\"p50\": 34.6, \"p95\": 118.9, \"p99\": 221.4, \"memory_mb\": 9800}"
```
Jordan: Once legal signs off and tokenizer PR merges, I'll flip the canary route and kick warmup. Need thumbs-up from runtime after pre-canary smoke.
Leo: Quick smoke on dedicated pool passed for seq=512/1024. Running seq=2048 test tonight; will post results. If memory thrash appears, recommend lowering canary batch size or enabling fp16 fallback.
models-bot: canary slot reserved: 2026-03-20T10:00:00Z-2026-03-20T12:00:00Z for mdl_6201112222_tessera6b.
Sam: Note for ML evals — embedding shape fix affects several eval scripts. Tagging @ml-evals so they can rerun once merge lands.
ml-evals-bot: scheduled eval rerun for tessera6b after PR merge: job=eval-6201112222-1.
Natalie: Ack — will finish license check Thu morning. If CLA not provided, we either remove the tokenizer binary or vendor it with clear provenance and a compatible CLA.
Mia: Owners & next steps summary:
- infra canary owner: Jordan
- license reviewer: Natalie
- tokenizer/curation: Sam
- runtime reviewer: Leo
Plan: legal sign-off Thu AM -> tokenizer PR merged Thu afternoon -> canary Fri 10:00-12:00 UTC.
Mia: Call out blockers now if any.
Jordan: No infra blockers besides pending legal.
Sam: Aiming to merge tokenizer PR Thu by 16:00 UTC; QA smoke requested.
Leo: Will post 2048 run results tonight. If problematic, will propose reduced batch or fp16 fallback.
Mia: Thanks all. If all green post-canary, I'll mark tessera6b as \"catalog-ready: canary completed\" and update the intake board.
Sam: :thumbsup:  
Jordan: :+1:  
Natalie: :white_check_mark:
